formal_statement: ∀ (q m : ℕ) (S : Fin m → Finset (Fin m)), 2 ≤ q → m = q * q + q + 1 → (∀ i : Fin m, (S i).card = q + 1) → (∀ i j : Fin m, i ≠ j → (S i ∩ S j).card = 1) → (∀ p : Fin m, (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin m => p ∈ S i)).card = q + 1) → ∀ (gates : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (out : Fin m → ℕ), (∀ g ∈ gates, (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not) ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2) → (∃ ι : Fin 1 → Fin gates.length, ∀ i : Fin gates.length, (gates.get i).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not → ∃ j : Fin 1, ι j = i) → (∀ (w : Fin m) (x : Fin m → Bool), PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨gates, out w⟩ (List.ofFn x) = decide (∃ v ∈ S w, x v = true)) → m * q ≤ gates.length
plain_statement: Conjecture, no argument held. Take q at least 2 and m = q^2 + q + 1 points and as many lines, each line of q + 1 points, two lines meeting in exactly one point, each point on q + 1 lines. Every list of AND, OR and NOT gates of at most two wires, with at most one NOT gate, whose outputs give the OR of each line on every input, has at least m q gates, the size of the plain circuit without NOT gates. Computed, not checked: 14 at q = 2 with any number of NOT gates.
title: One NOT gate saves nothing on the line-ORs of a projective plane of order q: at least q times the number of lines gates
